why_not_alternatives.exec_serial_all_files: Time (36s) is much higher than our pipeline (9s), violates efficiency requirement while providing same recall.
why_not_alternatives.exec_union_all_files: Peak memory (0.7GB) is close to limit (0.8GB) but our pipeline uses lower memory (0.4GB) while maintaining recall.
why_not_alternatives.exec_batched_candidates: Time (18s) is double our pipeline's time (9s) without memory advantage, less optimal.

validation_rule: True positives are hardcoded secrets directly assigned in source code (e.g., HARDCODED_PASSWORD = "hunter2") or bearer/token values written into logs. Exclude environment-variable reads, comments, and runtime template strings that interpolate a token instead of hardcoding.
